description: Get last-chance / vandaag-af / clearance items from an Albert Heijn store. Uses store_id if given, else the store nearest postal_code, else the member's favourite store (set in the AH app), else the store nearest the member's address. Returns the store it used. Uses the dedicated bargainItems GraphQL endpoint which returns today-only markdown deals. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20)

postal_code.description: Dutch postal code (e.g. '1234AB') to find the nearest store when store_id is not known.

store_id.description: AH store ID from ah_search_stores (default: the member's favourite store)

name: ah_get_last_chance_items
title: Albert Heijn: Last-Chance Items
